title: dedicated-autoscaler-throughput-burst-controls-and-utilization-reporting-enhancement
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: improve Dedicated fleet autoscaler to provide configurable throughput guarantees while preserving transient burst capacity and improving utilization reporting. This change implements a token-bucket based burst control with smoothing, introduces a new per-fleet throughput_guarantee config, and expands prometheus metrics and internal reporting to make utilization and burst usage visible to operators. The goal is to allow customers to set conservative guaranteed throughput (for SLA adherence) while still allowing short-term bursts and providing observability that explains cost/latency tradeoffs. Changes: 1) autoscaler core: add throughput_guarantee and burst_bucket parameters, token-bucket implementation with leaky refill and smoothing. 2) scheduler: integrate burst admission checks and fallback routing to compatible model variants when guarantee cannot be met. 3) reporting: new metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_guarantee, dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens, dedicated_autoscaler_effective_utilization) and storage hooks to roll up fleet-level utilization. 4) control plane API: config schema, validation, and migration for existing fleets. 5) e2e + load tests and docs updates. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep existing behavior if throughput_guarantee is unset. Migration: migration script migrates legacy fleet configs to include default guarantee (0). Rollout plan: staged canary over two weeks, telemetry checks for correctness and regressions. Linked work: ENG-2143 for autoscaler design doc, SUP-7821 for customer incident that motivated improved observability.

release_notes: Added throughput_guarantee and burst controls to Dedicated autoscaler. New metrics to observe effective utilization and burst consumption. Default behavior unchanged unless config is set. See docs/enterprise/dedicated/autoscaler.md for migration and console examples.
